Chapter 304: Chapter 9: Net Worth Skyrockets (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 304: Chapter 9: Net Worth Skyrockets (Please Subscribe)

Seventh Rank Evolvers who wish to ascend to Eighth Rank Evolvers find that the method of “Opening the World” is crucial.

It refers to creating an Inner World within oneself, which is one of the prerequisites for a breakthrough to the Eighth Layer.

Here, the Inner World is not some minor space,

but a real world in which life can flourish and pass down its heritage.

Consider this,

the physical bodies of human evolvers, when compared with those special life forms lurking deep within the cosmic starry skies that rival planets in size,

...

are indeed too weak.

For example, a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, which can reach Sixth Rank at adulthood and devours planets as its food,

a Sixth Rank human evolver is just as tasty a morsel in front of an adult Starry Sky Wanderer Kun; to not flee is to die.

This is the great disparity brought by factors like physical capability, bloodline, species, and others. Under similar rank conditions, these special life forms are almost invincible.

However, by the Eighth Layer, the gap between human evolvers and those special beings rapidly narrows and might even turn into an advantage for humans.

The fundamental reason lies in the Inner World opened up by the method of “Opening the World.”

With a world to support them, even if this world is not large, the full power of a complete world still lets the human evolvers attain an astonishing level of depth.

To Open the World and create an Inner World,

one must at least be at the Seventh-Rank Peak to hope to attempt it; it can only fully take shape at the Eighth Layer.

However—

From the information sent by Lin Yuan, Great Scholar Tai’e saw the possibility of a Seventh Rank Evolver “Opening the World”.

This is truly…

From the perspective of Great Scholar Tai’e, it was clear that Lin Yuan’s theory came with many limitations and conditions.

For instance, it required understanding all the space base models at the Sixth Rank, and the Dao one controlled had to be perfect, and so on.

Such a method was destined to be exclusive; most ordinary evolvers simply didn’t possess the insight.

Only the true peak geniuses of humanity could hope to attempt this direction.

Nonetheless, the theories proposed by Lin Yuan, compared with those conceived by human evolutionary scholars of the past about creating an Inner World before the Eighth Layer, had a possible chance of realization.

The evolutionary scholars of the past did indeed research methods to create an Inner World before an Eighth Layer breakthrough,

but there were many more conditions, often requiring the assistance of rare cosmic treasures.

For example, one method involved consuming a ‘World Fruit’ at the Seventh Rank and then refining it with special techniques.

But World Fruits… how precious are they?

To use them to open an Inner World for a Seventh Rank Evolver? Such a waste.

“Which evolutionary scholar?”

On Chikun Main Star, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged,

staring at the message replied by “Tai’e” the founder, momentarily lost in thought.

Evolutionary scholar… Lin Yuan did know that this was a treasure of human civilization.

But to become an evolutionary scholar, strength was secondary,

the key was to create a stable, complete, novel Eighth Layer evolutionary system.

Over millions of years in the Chikun Star Domain, only three evolutionary scholars were born,

and these scholars had long since headed to the Central Star Domain of human civilization.

“Is it because of those concepts I spoke of?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, recalling the Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter concepts he shared with “Tai’e”, the founder, which involved using Taiji and spatial rules to open a small world.

However, this idea was only suitable for Lin Yuan.

So far, only Lin Yuan managed to achieve it,

not to say anything about others; just fully understanding the basic spatial model at the Sixth Rank

would be enough to block almost all evolvers.

Of course, in Lin Yuan’s vision, the Seventh Stage Martial Tao contains many cultivation directions.

To comprehend the Space Rules was just one of them,

other Martial Arts Evolvers, upon reaching the peak of Sixth Rank,

if they cannot comprehend the Space Rules, may focus on the rules they excel at.

But without the Space Rules, they cannot create an Inner World at the Seventh Rank.

This was, after all, a trade-off, and Lin Yuan had no intention of noting in the Seventh Rank Chapter that understanding the fundamental space model could lead to an early “Opening the World”.

It would cause other Martial Tao evolvers to forcibly try to comprehend Space Rules at Six Rank, in pursuit of “Opening the World”.

“I am not an evolutionary scholar,” Lin Yuan replied.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path hasn’t even begun to open a Seventh Rank Chapter to this day, let alone commence an Eighth Layer Part.

“Not an evolutionary scholar?”

Great Scholar Tai’e frowned; he also felt that Lin Yuan wasn’t an evolutionary scholar and had sensed it during their previous conversation.

But.

If you’re not an evolutionary scholar, how could you develop a direction and concept for Seventh Rankers to open an Inner World?

It wasn’t that the Great Scholar Tai’e looked down on evolvers below the evolutionary scholars,

but without reaching that level, how could one have the soul power and computational ability to deduce such concepts?

“Could it be that such a genius truly exists in this world…”

For a moment, Great Scholar Tai’e felt somewhat disinterested; since he entered the evolutionary path, he was considered a genius among countless evolvers.

The favoritism from the upper echelons of human civilization, the affections of the three goddesses, and more made Great Scholar Tai’e very confident.

But seeing Lin Yuan, Great Scholar Tai’e suddenly thought that he might be “getting old”.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s expression turned reflective.

“Could it be that this founder ‘Tai’e’, is an evolutionary scholar?”

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

The number of evolutionary scholars is extremely scant, far fewer than Eighth Rank Evolvers.

Within the circle of Virtual World founders, they were all certainly founders of an evolutionary path,

but how many of them could actually develop a complete Eighth Rank Evolutionary Path?
